entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support Blazor Server identity changes during SignalR authentication refresh #68284
  • ANCM FILE_WATCHER: app_offline.htm notification match compares buffer capacity instead of string length, making the match path unreachable #68283
  • build has dependencies on VS2022 build tools #68273
  • Quarantine flaky IIS Express RequestResponseTests class (36 methods) due to connection failures #68271
  • Tighten the HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 `:path` guard to the printable-ASCII bound #68270
  • Support unions in ValidationsGenerator #68268

Closed

  • Build scripts hard-disable MSBuild node reuse, hurting inner-loop perf and blocking MSBuild Server #68251
